races.name: Happy 80th Birthday William 'Bill' Carr Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
GREEN STAR's latest Redcar fourth was underwhelming but he sets the standard on his opening Chester second prior to that and is given another chance from the inside stall under Buick. War Gaming is the obvious form threat, although the selection's stablemate High Tower has the potential to leave his Salisbury debut behind.

  1. GREEN STAR (IRE)
  2. WAR GAMING (IRE)
  3. HIGH TOWER

races.name: William Hill Price Boosts Every Day Nursery
races.verdict:
The thriving KING OF PERSIA is selected to make light of a 6 lb-penalty and complete a hat-trick. Ralph Beckett's last-time-out Ripon scorer Aphra Behn still looks fairly treated off a 4 lb rise and is feared most ahead of Gemma Tutty's Bella Lucia.

  1. KING OF PERSIA
  2. APHRA BEHN
  3. BELLA LUCIA

races.name: British Stallion Studs EBF Silver Tankard Stakes (Listed)
races.verdict:
KING HIGH's near miss in the Haynes Hanson & Clark at Newbury is the best form on offer and he appeals as capable of better again so he's the one to beat. Silverella has impressed when winning her last 2 outings (C&D latest) and looks up to making an impact in this higher grade. Ayr debut scorer Tyrrhenian Thunder is next on the list.

  1. KING HIGH
  2. SILVERELLA
  3. TYRRHENIAN THUNDER

races.name: British Stallion Studs EBF Fillies' Handicap
races.verdict:
The return to a stiff 6f looks ideal for DANDY MAGIC, who is very much at the top of her game at present. Lady Roxby also arrives in good nick and is likely to be a threat if the outside stall isn't too troublesome. Ghisa is next on the list.

  1. DANDY MAGIC (IRE)
  2. LADY ROXBY
  3. GHISA (IRE)

races.name: Phil Bull Trophy Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
IN THE BREEZE's second to a handicap blot in the Old Borough Cup at Haydock last month is a solid piece of form and he can prove too strong for August's Goodwood 1-2 Maxident and Moon Over Miami.

  1. IN THE BREEZE (IRE)
  2. MAXIDENT
  3. MOON OVER MIAMI (FR)

races.name: Napoleons Casino Bradford Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
The lightly-raced BNAIDER should be spot on for this after a recent run at Salisbury and is taken to resume his progression and prove too strong for fellow 3-y-o Night Patrol. Impartiality's overall consistency suggests he can bounce back from a rare below-par run last time and also play a prominent role.

  1. BNAIDER
  2. NIGHT PATROL (IRE)
  3. IMPARTIALITY

races.name: William Hill Best Odds Guaranteed Handicap
races.verdict:
ANOTHER BAAR has dropped to a very handy mark and has shaped as if back on decent terms with himself without really getting the rub of the green on his last 2 outings, so gets the verdict over Vantheman, who should prove suited by this drop back to 5f and the in-form Brummell.

  1. ANOTHER BAAR
  2. VANTHEMAN (IRE)
  3. BRUMMELL (IRE)

races.name: SW Hire Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
races.verdict:
OCEAN HEIGHTS has been in good form over hurdles of late and can land what looks a weak race returning to the Flat. Lilykoy and Star of Jupiter look the main dangers.

  1. OCEAN HEIGHTS
  2. LILYKOY
  3. STAR OF JUPITER (IRE)

races.name: MJ Church Nursery
races.verdict:
DUTY'S CALL did enough on her nursery debut last time to suggest she can defy this mark. Dreams Galore has a fine strike rate since handicapping and can chase the selection home, with Chief Minister and Knock Three Times others to consider.

  1. DUTY'S CALL (IRE)
  2. DREAMS GALORE (IRE)
  3. CHIEF MINISTER

races.name: Big Stage Hire Handicap
races.verdict:
The drop back in trip may not be enough to stop course specialist SILVER WRAITH from adding to her record. An Outlaw's Grace is well treated if bouncing back to form, while Over Spiced can't be discounted.

  1. SILVER WRAITH
  2. AN OUTLAW'S GRACE (IRE)
  3. OVER SPICED

races.name: Elite Racing Club Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
AL QAYED was narrowly denied here last time and can go one better to get off the mark. Chapron shaped with promise on debut and may prove next best from the improving Finger Cross.

  1. AL QAYED (IRE)
  2. CHAPRON
  3. FINGER CROSS (IRE)

races.name: Wiltshire And Bath Air Ambulance Nursery
races.verdict:
An open-looking nursery with the vote going to AGITATOR, who has shown more of what he's about back at a more realistic level recently and Oliver Cole's charge can double his tally in reapplied cheekpieces. Kaito was unable to reward favourite backers on his recent nursery debut, but he's worth another chance quickly returned to turf, with High Calibre rounding off the shortlist partnered by Sean Levey for the first time.

  1. AGITATOR
  2. KAITO
  3. HIGH CALIBRE

races.name: DJSN Ltd Handicap
races.verdict:
This represents a significant drop in class for ELECTRIFARHH, so Ed Walker's filly gets the tentative vote to open her handicap account at the expense of Talis Evolvere, who returned to form when third at Southwell last month and he's never been lower in the weights. Signcastle City and Knights Gold can fight out minor honours.

  1. ELECTRIFARHH
  2. TALIS EVOLVERE (IRE)
  3. SIGNCASTLE CITY (IRE)

races.name: Elite Racing Club Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict:
A huge field but SPIRIT LEAD ME capitalised on a much-reduced mark at Southwell 11 days ago and while he may not have shown form on turf for some time, Richard Hughes' charge is difficult to resist from this mark. Dalmally got up late on to gain a first handicap success at Brighton last time, so he's feared most now back in the groove, with Sub Thirteen and stable-switcher Sceptic rounding off the shortlist.

  1. SPIRIT LEAD ME (IRE)
  2. DALMALLY
  3. SUB THIRTEEN

races.name: Elite Racing Club Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict:
REDHOT WHISPER is back in more realistic company so this looks a better opportunity for him to build on his Chepstow success. Pebble Dash is also drawn wide but has to be respected after his Ffos Las win, with course regular Blue Hero also considered.

  1. REDHOT WHISPER (IRE)
  2. PEBBLE DASH (IRE)
  3. BLUE HERO (CAN)

races.name: bettingsites.co.uk Compare Before You Bet Apprentice Handicap
races.verdict:
BURFORD BEAUTY and Distillate both landed gambles recently and they top the shortlist, the former marginally preferred. Camera Shy is another to consider after a more encouraging run last time.

  1. BURFORD BEAUTY (IRE)
  2. DISTILLATE
  3. CAMERA SHY (IRE)

races.name: bettingsites.co.uk Best Betting Offers EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
LANCASTER TOWER has shown more than enough to suggest he can win one of these and this looks an excellent opportunity. Five Years' much improved second at Catterick is backed up by the timefigure so is second choice ahead of National Pride.

  1. LANCASTER TOWER
  2. FIVE YEARS
  3. NATIONAL PRIDE (IRE)

races.name: bettingsites.co.uk Best Odds Guaranteed Handicap
races.verdict:
JENEVER could be the answer back down in class off an easing mark. Hat-trick seeking Go Lockers Go is an obvious threat, with Massimo Blue also considered.

  1. JENEVER
  2. GO LOCKERS GO
  3. MASSIMO BLUE

races.name: bettingsites.co.uk Free Bets Offers Nursery
races.verdict:
LADY HENSHAW is progressing well and she could be let in lightly given the form of her C&D win. Casino Star got back on the up here 11 days ago and rates a big threat back at 6f, while Bahia Bonita is another who has made encouraging strides forward.

  1. LADY HENSHAW (IRE)
  2. CASINO STAR (IRE)
  3. BAHIA BONITA

races.name: bettingsites.co.uk Find Your New Bookmaker Handicap
races.verdict:
It could be worth keeping the faith with BEARISH who returns from a break following a gelding operation. Elite Approach is proving most progressive so is feared most ahead of Yankee Dude and Moonlight Warrior.

  1. BEARISH (IRE)
  2. ELITE APPROACH
  3. YANKEE DUDE (IRE)

races.name: bettingsites.co.uk New Betting Sites Handicap
races.verdict:
The form of YAZOO's handicap debut win at Wolverhampton has worked out well so he must be given another chance having had excuses next time. Ballybunion continues to shape quite well, while Alembic is worth a second look on handicap bow.

  1. YAZOO
  2. BALLYBUNION (IRE)
  3. ALEMBIC

races.name: bettingsites.co.uk For Fast Withdrawals Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
One time Oaks prospect I'M THE ONE is unraced since running in the Cheshire Oaks but is the clear pick eased in grade. Amazonica may yet have more to come and is second choice ahead of Joulany.

  1. I'M THE ONE
  2. AMAZONICA (IRE)
  3. JOULANY (IRE)

races.name: bettingsites.co.uk Handicap
races.verdict:
She may be proving difficult to win with but WE'VE GOT THIS fared better than of late back on all-weather/upped in trip when finishing runner-up at Newcastle recently and given how well she saw it out, this extra 1f should be withing reach. She gets the vote over Symphony's Song, who has tumbled in the weights and the booking of the newly-crowned Champion Jockey looks noteworthy. Recent C&D scorer Spec of Light rounds off the shortlist.

  1. WE'VE GOT THIS (IRE)
  2. SYMPHONY'S SONG
  3. SPEC OF LIGHT

races.name: Download The At The Races App Nursery (Div 1)
races.verdict:
HOOSIER took a step forward on her debut for Marco Botti and she looks to have been let off rather lightly ahead of her nursery bow. Godolphin's Stormy Winter is a likely improver in this company and can pose the biggest threat.

  1. HOOSIER (IRE)
  2. STORMY WINTER
  3. ALFEY MOON

races.name: Download The At The Races App Nursery (Div 2)
races.verdict:
HELLO YOU TEN left his turf form well behind when an excellent second at Southwell recently and a repeat of that form from an unchanged mark may well suffice. Printing Money also looks more at home on this surface and is feared most, ahead of Ventura Power.

  1. HELLO YOU TEN (IRE)
  2. PRINTING MONEY (IRE)
  3. VENTURA POWER

races.name: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Handicap
races.verdict:
A competitive handicap in which preference goes to recent C&D winner STAR OF MALI, whose smooth-travelling style seemed to lend itself very well to the track when scoring here earlier in the month. Powder Monkey, Mudamer and the returning Champion Again Ole also hold claims.

  1. STAR OF MALI (IRE)
  2. POWDER MONKEY (IRE)
  3. MUDAMER (IRE)

races.name: Race And Rest - Wolverhampton Holiday Inn Conditions Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
MEYDAAN has not been seen since finishing third in the Dubai World Cup in March, but he is well suited by these conditions and should have enough class to make a winning return without being fully wound up. Stablemate Treble Tee is respected back on a synthetic surface after winning at Newcastle in June, while Al Zanati is also of interest back on all-weather.

  1. MEYDAAN (IRE)
  2. TREBLE TEE (IRE)
  3. AL ZANATI

races.name: Cavani Best Dressed Handicap
races.verdict:
This looks really open but KNEBWORTH Is a very reliable operator on all-weather so is awarded the vote. Jax Edge is well drawn to adopt her customary tactics and she's dangerous if getting into her rhythm, while Silent Strike should have more to offer post gelding operation.

  1. KNEBWORTH
  2. JAX EDGE
  3. SILENT STRIKE (IRE)

races.name: Cavani Tailored Champion Handicap
races.verdict:
Lightly-raced 3-y-o DANCE FANTASY looks interesting in this grade with Oisin Murphy taking over, and she may improve to get the better of stablemates Savannah Smiles and Macarone. Imagine That and My Mate Kev complete the shortlist in a wide-open sprint.

  1. DANCE FANTASY (IRE)
  2. SAVANNAH SMILES (IRE)
  3. MACARONE

races.name: attheraces.com/marketmovers Handicap
races.verdict:
THE ANTHONY GOVER is fancied to make it 3 wins from 4 starts over C&D. Albertini Star bids to make it 2-2 under Oisin Murphy and heads the dangers along with fellow 3-y-o Celtic Chariot. No Knee Never and Renesmee complete the shortlist for this competitive handicap.

  1. THE ANTHONY GOVER
  2. ALBERTINI STAR (IRE)
  3. CELTIC CHARIOT (IRE)

races.name: Follow attheraces On Instagram Handicap
races.verdict:
Quite a few arrive in form but Irish raider LETHIMFLY does still stand out as being well treated having dipped to 12 lb lower than when second at Dundalk earlier in the year. His draw isn't ideal but he shaped as if back in form last time and is preferred to Invincible Crown, Blue Force and Oisin Murphy's mount Little Jaybee.

  1. LETHIMFLY (IRE)
  2. INVINCIBLE CROWN (IRE)
  3. BLUE FORCE (IRE)

races.name: Book Now At wolverhampton-racecourse.co.uk Fillies' Handicap
races.verdict:
CALL MARGOT's recent turf form hasn't been too inspiring but that has enabled her to drop to her winning mark and with the return to all-weather in her favour, she could bounce back in style. Sunlit Sea seems very likely to give it another good go, with Got The Booty also of interest.

  1. CALL MARGOT (IRE)
  2. SUNLIT SEA
  3. GOT THE BOOTY (FR)

meeting_summary.going: Chase: good-good to firm in places; hurdle: good-good to soft in places

races.name: Betty Chantler Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
BASS HUNTER was one of the best British bumper horses last season and sure to be very well prepared for this hurdling debut, he should take some stopping. Anniversary tries to concede 6 lb to the selection but he has experience on his side and he can give it a good go. Marnier was also useful on the Flat so merits respect.

  1. BASS HUNTER (FR)
  2. ANNIVERSARY
  3. MARNIER (IRE)

races.name: SIS Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
MARKET HOUSE may prove too strong for A Tickatickatiming and notch a third hurdle success under Sean Bowen. Gone Country could have a big say if ready to roll.

  1. MARKET HOUSE (IRE)
  2. A TICKATICKATIMING
  3. GONE COUNTRY (IRE)

races.name: Back British Farming Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
Neither GOLLY GOSH nor Expert Analysis looked a particularly easy ride when second and third at Stratford 2 weeks ago but they may still come to the fore here, preferred in that order assuming the Ellis inmate turns out quickly from Market Rasen. Of the rest, Alidam (stablemate of Expert Analysis) requires a market check.

  1. GOLLY GOSH (IRE)
  2. EXPERT ANALYSIS (IRE)
  3. ALIDAM (FR)

races.name: Bet Goodwin Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
NAP HAND has match fitness on his side and is taken to resume winning ways in a race that could pan out favourably. Tashan and Cayman Dancer both look potentially dangerous on seasonal reappearance.

  1. NAP HAND (IRE)
  2. TASHAN
  3. CAYMAN DANCER

races.name: Nick And Valda Embiricos Memorial Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
The race PALAMON won at Southwell last week rather fell apart but he could do no more than win very easily and he looks up to defying a penalty. There may well be more to come from Tapley for his new yard so he can offer most resistance.

  1. PALAMON (IRE)
  2. TAPLEY
  3. JOREBEL (FR)

races.name: Trottenden Farm Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
LATIN has made a promising start for Olly Murphy and may be rewarded with a first hurdle success. Bohemian Breeze is lightly raced in this sphere and looks a threat along with Ez Tiger, who won this corresponding race 12 months ago.

  1. LATIN (IRE)
  2. BOHEMIAN BREEZE (IRE)
  3. EZ TIGER (IRE)

races.name: Aldaniti Mares' Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
MILD MAGIC was on the up when finishing runner-up here on her final start of last season, and she looks the percentage call. Burning Embers could be much better than she's shown to date and is feared (especially if supported), while Where's Cato is by no means a back number.

  1. MILD MAGIC (IRE)
  2. BURNING EMBERS (IRE)
  3. WHERE'S CATO (IRE)

races.name: Golf At Gowran Park Nursery Handicap (0-60)
races.verdict:
WINNIE’S WISH had no chance to show what she could do when trapped on the rail at Galway in July and, now 4 lb lower with first-time blinkers applied, he could find the improvement required to land this. Littlepacer is feared most back on turf after a creditable all-weather debut, with Fairyhouse near-misser Cudawudashuda also respected.

  1. WINNIE'S WISH (IRE)
  2. LITTLEPACER (IRE)
  3. CUDAWUDASHUDA (IRE)

races.name: Dine At Gowran Park Handicap
races.verdict:
NAZARIO looks well treated on his C&D fourth last month. He gets the nod over Cisterna, who won easily at Roscommon last week, while Caislean Ni Cuan is worth considering with Colin Keane aboard first time.

  1. NAZARIO (IRE)
  2. CISTERNA (IRE)
  3. CAISLEAN NI CUAN (IRE)

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden
races.verdict:
Horses with experience have been favoured in recent renewals of this race. FLAMBE FLEUR and Wo Wo Never fit that bill, and it's the sole filly in the race who gets the nod, with her debut form working out very well. Aidan O'Brien's Paraguay is the sole runner with a Group 1 entry and needs a close look along with Paythebelievers. Acknowledge may do best of the newcomers.

  1. FLAMBE FLEUR
  2. WO WO NEVER (IRE)
  3. PARAGUAY (USA)

races.name: Irish EBF Median Sires Series Fillies Maiden (Smullen Series)
races.verdict:
CHURCHILL BOND reacted well to the visor at Listowel last month and can strike for Paddy Twomey and Billy Lee. Golden Gift and Handsoffshesmine can give her most to do on the back of promising debut efforts in recent weeks.

  1. CHURCHILL BOND
  2. GOLDEN GIFT
  3. HANDSOFFSHESMINE (IRE)

races.name: Racing Club Membership Handicap (0-60) (Div 1)
races.verdict:
REAL PETITE won over this C&D in June and, though her form dipped in mid-summer, she has bounced back with 2 encouraging efforts here. She seems sure to go close off a career-low mark, with Kingcharles feared most back at 1m if belatedly building on his Navan run and Arizona Star a player if this becomes enough of a stamina test.

  1. REAL PETITE (GER)
  2. KINGCHARLES (FR)
  3. ARIZONA STAR (IRE)

races.name: Racing Club Membership Handicap (0-60) (Div 2)
races.verdict:
A very tricky puzzle and a chance is taken on RAMPAGE, who has a much better draw than when an eye-catching second here last month. Princess Chloe, The Blue Panther and Miss Americana head an extensive list of dangers.

  1. RAMPAGE (IRE)
  2. PRINCESS CHLOE (IRE)
  3. THE BLUE PANTHER (IRE)

races.name: Gowran Park Racing Club Fillies Maiden
races.verdict:
SHANALA had a lack of stamina as a possible excuse over 11f at Killarney last time. She had made steady progress prior to that and can bounce back returned to shorter. Fleur de Provence and Sangreal can give Johnny Murtagh's charge most to do.

  1. SHANALA (IRE)
  2. FLEUR DE PROVENCE (IRE)
  3. SANGREAL (IRE)

races.name: Racing Again November 7th Handicap
races.verdict:
LORD AUS produced comfortably his best effort yet when narrowly denied at Listowel last month and, with cheekpieces back on having won in them at Limerick in June, is fancied to go one better in a very competitive handicap. Love Orchid is feared most if settling better than last time with No More Hiding, Neo Smart and Saliba also dangerous.

  1. LORD AUS (IRE)
  2. LOVE ORCHID (IRE)
  3. NO MORE HIDING
  4. NEO SMART (IRE)

Prix De La Villa Les Abeilles Handicap
Prix De La Foret De Cinglais Handicap
Prix De La Foret D'eawy Handicap
Prix De La Foret D'ecouves Handicap
Prix De La Foret De Cerisy Handicap
